verification.scope: Canonical saved catalogue, existing owner-private overlay and identified saved exports only. This run checked schema, exact export equality, order, IDs and source privacy; it did not recapture playlists or assume access to other conversations or devices.

unresolved.note: Captured display credits and native source context are preserved; uploader identity is not assumed to be the performing artist.
Native track permalinks and saved recording versions are retained; a numeric ID was not present in these captured rows. Do not invent IDs or YouTube equivalents.

backfill.note: All accessible owner snapshots are complete. The 62 public index-only rows are intentional privacy placeholders, not permission to publish private memberships.

replay.note: Fresh temporary queues are generated from exact archived IDs and are not saved public playlists. SoundCloud remixes retain native source and individual track links.

device_scope.hosted_cache: Refreshes when reopened online; revision includes the owner overlay.
device_scope.downloaded_files: Snapshots until replaced; no inaccessible device was updated.
device_scope.audio: No streaming audio downloaded. Offline exports preserve tracklists and links, not offline streaming.

notifications.policy: Suppress unchanged routine success. Report each concrete blocker once until its situation changes.
